author: PBS Space Time
description:
What if we could turn our entire solar system into a spaceship, using the Sun itself as an engine to travel across the galaxy? From giant solar sails to fusion-powered stellar engines, we explore the extraordinary technologies that could one day let humanity steer our solar system through the Milky Way.
